decision_target: Whether a Gift Aid claim can be made on a specific donation
decision_unit: one donation transaction (FP-0316-EL from Elaine Carter), though the scenario involves multiple donors and transactions which may each require separate assessment

atoms.proposition: The organisation claiming Gift Aid is recognised as a charity or CASC for tax purposes
The donation was made by an individual (not a company or other entity)
The donor has paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the relevant tax year as the total Gift Aid being claimed on their donations in that year
The donor has made a Gift Aid declaration giving the charity permission to claim Gift Aid on the donation
The donation was NOT made through Payroll Giving
The donation is NOT a payment for goods or services, and is NOT made because the charity or CASC bought goods or services
The donor does NOT receive a benefit in exchange for the donation that exceeds the permitted limit
atoms.entity_scope: the donor and the donation transaction

atoms.proposition: The donation is NOT a donation of shares
The donation was NOT made via a charity card or voucher (e.g. CAF vouchers)

scope_issues: The customer scenario involves multiple donors (monthly direct debit payers and one-off donors). Each donation transaction from each donor must be assessed individually against all conditions. The atoms above apply per-donation and per-donor; a single eligibility determination cannot cover all transactions simultaneously.
The tax-year condition in a3 is cumulative across all Gift Aid claims made on a given donor's donations in the same tax year, not just the single transaction in question.
limitations: The passages do not specify the exact monetary threshold for a donor 'benefit' that would disqualify a donation (a7); only that a limit exists.
The passages do not detail what documentation beyond a Gift Aid declaration is required, nor specify the form the declaration must take.
The passages do not address the process or timing requirements for submitting a Gift Aid claim to HMRC.
E06 and E03/E04 contain overlapping but slightly differently worded conditions on donor tax payments; both have been captured in a3 as a single atom reflecting the combined meaning.
